Coolwulf IME is an advanced physical keyboard for Android with support for modifiers, LED indicators, and navigation mode.
To get started, you need to enable Coolwulf IME as an input method in Android Settings. Tap the button below to open settings.
After enabling Coolwulf IME, select it as your default keyboard. Tap the button below to choose the input method.

Coolwulf IME shows 5 LEDs in the status bar that indicate modifier status:

• Shift: blue when active, red when locked
• SYM: blue for emoji, red for special characters
• Ctrl: blue when active, red when locked
• Alt: blue when active, red when locked

Gray LEDs indicate the modifier is off.

Nav Mode allows you to navigate using letter keys as shortcuts.

To activate:
• Press Ctrl twice quickly
• Letter keys are mapped to navigation functions
• Press Ctrl again to deactivate

You can customize the mappings in advanced settings.

Coolwulf IME offers many customization options:

• Customizable keyboard layouts
• Launcher shortcuts
• Auto-correction
• Custom mappings for Nav Mode

Explore the settings to find the perfect configuration for you!
You are now ready to use Coolwulf IME! Remember that you can always return to settings to further customize the keyboard to your needs.
